Name: Abigail Sebastian Sam Poly Events and Dialogue
Author: volunteer46
Description:
[center][b][size=6]ASSPoly Events and Dialogue[/size]
[/b][size=4]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/volunteer46]volunteer46[/url][/size][/center]
This is an "Immersive Polyamory" mod that adds new events and different dialogues if you are planning to date Abigail, Sam, and Sebastian. The pacing of this story is meant to be a little slow. Rather than bombarding you with one event after the other, the events were meant to be a bit spaced out as if you were taking your time romancing the characters rather than speedrunning it.
You will still have to download a different mod that allows you to have different spouses, but this adds, hopefully, a more 'romantic' polyamorous story that the three will have with the farmer.
This mod is currently only fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url] by aedenthorn. If you are using any other poly mod, please scroll down to the configuration section to explain what to do (it's just checking a box, nothing hard).

[color=#3c78d8][size=5][font=Arial][b]What does this mod include?[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]New Events[/size][/color][/b]
There are 8 new events added into the mod that are triggered as your hearts increase with each of the characters.

[b][size=3]4-Heart Event:[/size][/b]
[b]Description- [/b]This is a starter event that sets up the story.
[spoiler]Hints that Sebastian and Abigail might have feelings for each other, and that Sam has some feelings for Sebastian. We love a love triangle![/spoiler]
[b]How to Trigger-[/b]
[spoiler]Be at least 4 hearts with both Sebastian and Sam. Enter Sam's House on a weekday.[/spoiler]

[b]6-Heart Event:[/b]
[b]Description-[/b]
[spoiler]Sebastian builds a new Solarian Chronicles campaign, and Abigail joins with Sam and the Farmer (NOTE: This is just dialogue for now; I might add a cutscene in the future).[/spoiler]
[b]How to Trigger-[/b]
[spoiler]See the original Solarian Chronicles Event. Be at least 6 Hearts with Abigail, Sebastian, and Sam. You will get a letter in the mail inviting you to Sebastian's room at a certain time.[/spoiler]

[b]8-Heart Event Part 1: 
Description-[/b]
[spoiler]The Farmer eavesdrops on a conversation between Abigail and Sebastian talking about their feelings for the Farmer.[/spoiler]
[b]How to Trigger-[/b]
[spoiler]You need to have at least seen the last 6-Heart Event, along with both Sebastian's and Abigail's 8-Heart Events. Be at least 8 Hearts with both Sebastian and Abigail. Walk into Pierre's Shop at any time of day.[/spoiler]

[b]8-Heart Event Part 2: 
Description-[/b]
[spoiler]Sebastian talks to Sam about what happened with Abigail. They also talk about their feelings for the Farmer.[/spoiler]
[b]How to Trigger-[/b]
[spoiler]You need to have seen the last 8-Heart Event with Sebastian and Abigail, and also have seen Sam's 8-Heart Event. Go into Sam's house any time of day. [/spoiler]

[b]10-Heart Event:[/b]
[b]Description-[/b]
[spoiler]The ASS trio talk to the Farmer about wanting to be in a polycule.[/spoiler]
[b]How to Trigger-[/b]
[spoiler]You need to be dating the three of them and must have seen all three of their 10-Heart Events. You will get a letter in the mail from Sam telling you to meet at Sebastian's place at 8pm.[/spoiler]

[b]Date Event:[/b]
[b]Description-[/b]
[spoiler]Now that the four are officially dating, they want to go on a date night at the Saloon![/spoiler]
[b]How to Trigger-[/b]
[spoiler]You must have seen the last 10-Heart event. You will get a letter in the mail on a Friday from one of them inviting you to a date night in the Saloon at 6pm.[/spoiler]
[b][u]NOTE: This event only triggers if you haven't married any of them.[/u][/b]

[b]14-Heart Event No Kids:[/b]
[b]Description-[/b]
[spoiler]The ASS trio want to have a picnic day to celebrate the time they've spent together with the Farmer.[/spoiler]
[b]How to Trigger-[/b]
[spoiler]The first part of this event will trigger in Spring at the farm once you are married to the three of them and have 14 Hearts with all three. Abigail will ask if you want to go on a picnic date. If you want to see the event with kids, answer "No." There is no penalty and the date will be pushed to when you have kids. If you say yes, she will tell you to go to the forest between 12pm and 8pm.[/spoiler]
[b][u]NOTE: If you see the second part of this event, you will not see the one with kids. They are very similar events, but I wanted to give two different options in case you, as the player, don't want to have kids. If you want to see the option with kids, ANSWER NO when Abigail asks you. If you skip the event before the question is asked, the default answer is "No".[/u][/b]

[b]14-Heart Event Kids: [/b]
[b]Description-[/b]
[spoiler]The Farmer and the ASS trio have made a happy family, and they want to spend some family time to appreciate their married life.[/spoiler]
[b]How to Trigger-[/b]
[spoiler]If you have 14 Hearts with the trio and two kids at toddler age, Abigail will tell you to meet them in the forest between 12pm and 7pm for a family picnic. This event only triggers if you answered "No" to the last time Abigail asked you about having a picnic.[/spoiler]
[b][u]NOTE: If you are choosing to see the event with kids, make sure you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7517]Custom Tokens[/url] by TheMightyAmondee mod downloaded [i]before[/i][/u][/b][u][i][b] [/b][/i][/u][b][u]you have kids![/u][/b]


[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]New Dialogue[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3][color=#ffffff]There are over 300 lines of dialogue added to Abigail, Sebastian, and Sam. Their daily dialogue before marriage is dependent on your heart level with them (4, 6, 8, 10). There are also new lines added during the engagement period, depending on the order in which you marry the three of them. Along with modified bouquet dialogue that is tweaked a bit to fit the story.[/color]
[color=#ffffff]In addition, there is a Family Reaction Dialogue once the polycule is confirmed![/color]
[color=#ffffff]Marriage dialogue has been tweaked and new lines added so they talk about each other. I've also noticed that with Free Love spouses could tend to start off the morning (before 1pm) with their spouse room line, so I added some more lines to change things up a bit. There is also some extra dialogue when you're having your first child. Finally, I have also added Birthday Dialogues so they reference each other's birthdays.[/color][/size]

[color=#3c78d8][size=5][b]Configuration
[/b][/size][/color]You can easily configure the settings for this mod by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
Right now, there are only three main settings you can configure.

[b]Enable Mod:[/b] Whether or not you want the mod enabled. Default it is checked for yes.

[b]Toddler Skin Color: [/b]This is for the 14-Heart Event with kids to show up correctly. Options are "Default" or "Dark"

[b]Married to Three:[/b] This is if you are [u]NOT [/u]using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url] Mod. Once you are married to all three, check the box to enable the marriage dialogue changes. Default is false. [u]LEAVE IT OFF and ignore it[/u] if you are using Free Love. The reason for this is that ASSPoly Events and Dialogue is currently fully compatible with only Free Love right now. While I am working on full compatibility for other poly mods like Poly Sweet, this box is your option if you're using any other poly mods. I have not fully tested this mod with other poly mods like Poly Sweet, so if you find a bug or error while having this box checked, please don't hesitate to reach out to me.

[color=#3c78d8][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
This mod really only requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and a polyamory mod. The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] is optional because you can edit the stuff yourself in the config file, but it just makes it easier to have GMCM.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url] is "optional," but it is currently the only poly mod that is fully compatible with this, so I'd suggest using Free Love.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7517]Custom Tokens[/url] is only required if you want to see the 14-Heart event with kids.

[color=#3c78d8][size=5][b]What Mods are Compatible?[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff]These are mods that are compatible and/or pair well with ASSPoly

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url][/b]- [/color][color=#6aa84f][b]Yes![/b][/color][color=#ffffff] I don't know how many times I've written this here but I can't stress it enough. This is currenly the only poly mod that is fully compatible with ASSPoly. [/color]

[b][color=#ffffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]Polyamory Sweet[/url]- [/color][color=#ffd966]Sort of. [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]You will have to make sure "MarriedtoThree" is set to true in the config once you are married to the ASS trio. This has not been fully tested with PolySweet, so some errors might happen. Please let me know if you encounter any.[/color]

[b][color=#ff7700][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20743]Pregnancy Choice-[/url][/color][/b][color=#ffffff] [/color][color=#6aa84f][b]Yes![/b][/color][color=#ffffff][b] [/b]My main worry was that this may clash with the last 14-Heart event, but everything works fine with this mod.[/color]

[color=#ffffff][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36459]HaveMoreKids-[/url] [/b][/color][color=#f1c232][b]Sort of. [/b][/color][color=#ffffff]This mod does work with Free Love, and it works with this one as well! But again, that last event with kids, just make sure your first two kids are a boy and a girl, or they might show up wrong in the event.[/color]

[color=#ff7700][b]Mods that change children's sprites-[/b][/color][color=#ffffff] [/color][b][color=#f1c232]Sort of?[/color][/b][color=#ffffff] They should work, depending on how the mod works; maybe the wrong sprite will show up in the last 14-heart event.[/color]

[color=#ff7700][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28676]Kali's Less Creepy Kids-[/url] [/b][/color][color=#6aa84f][b]Yes! [/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4]This is the mod I personally use to change the appearance of my kids, so I know this works with ASSPoly. After playing around with it a bit, though, I did notice that both kids in the event will just look like your "main spouse."[/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][b][url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-235#post-138263]Multiple Spouse Dialogues[/url][/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4][b] and [/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8840]Tia's Pack[/url][/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4][b]- [/b][/color][color=#6aa84f][b]Yes! [/b][/color][color=#ffffff]These mods aren't directly editing any of the marriage dialogue, so they won't override this mod and it actually pairs nicely![/color]


[color=#3c78d8][size=4][b]Final Notes
[/b][/size][/color][color=#ffffff][size=3]Please don't hesitate to contact me through here or on the SDV Discord if you run into any issues![/size][/color]
Thank you to the people on the SDV server who helped me create my very first mod.
Depending on how this is received, I am considering creating other "immersive polyamory" mods with other pairings, so please let me know if you'd like to see that and with whom!
